versions.changelog:
- Added explicit documentation for required and optional environment variables (API keys) in the skill metadata.
- Included provider-specific API key fields for Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, MiniMax, and Google models.
- Documented privacy details for both local (Mode A) and router (Mode B) modes in the metadata.
- Clarified that AUTO_MODEL_ROUTER_URL and learning mode are always opt-in and user-controlled.
- No changes to core logic—documentation and metadata only.

- Major update: Introduces a structured workflow for automatically selecting the best AI model per task.
- Adds explicit task categories (e.g., coding, math_reasoning, translation, daily_chat) to guide model selection.
- Supports two modes: local (self-classify tasks) and router-based (AI-assisted routing with feedback learning).
- Integrates user feedback to improve future routing when the router is configured.
- Allows users to customize model assignments for each category using simple commands.
- Provides better error handling and clear setup instructions for first-time users.
